source_text: These findings prompted the World Health Organization and UNAIDS in 2007 to endorse voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) as a key HIV prevention strategy in regions with generalized heterosexual epidemics, leading to the scale-up of programs that have delivered over 27 million procedures across 15 priority countries by 2023.
